contexts.text: Gomorrah () = persuasions of falsity. AC 1663. AC 1666.
Gomorrah = the love of self and the derivative cupidity of exercising command, from falsity.
Gomorrah = all falsity from the evil of the love of self.
The overthrow of Gomorrah = the damnation of falsity in general.
Samaria... as to falsities in general against the truths of faith, is called Gomorrah.
Egypt, in place of Gomorrah, = all the derivative falsity.
Fields and grapes of Gomorrah () = evils from falsities.
Gomorrah also is mentioned here... because Gomorrah = the falsity which is from the evil of the love of self... AC 7519:7.
A pit of salt, refers to Gomorrah.
Gomorrah = all the falsities of the evils which spring from the love of self. AE 653:5.
Its inhabitants as Gomorrah () = an evil life from falsities of doctrine.
Gomorrah = the destruction of all truth (through the love of self).
